title: Marginal Expectation of a Product Law
statement: Let $I$ be a finite index set, let each index $i$ have a finite sample space $A_i$ and a probability law $\mu_i$, and fix $j\in I$ and a function $f:A_j\to\mathbb{R}$. Under the product law with independent coordinates distributed according to the respective $\mu_i$, the expectation of $f$ evaluated at coordinate $j$ equals its expectation under $\mu_j$.
hypotheses_covered: $I$ is a finite index type with decidable equality
A probability law $\mu_i$ on each $A_i$ is specified
